label: TP
reason: User input flows directly to the response sink via string concatenation. The applied mitigation (replacing '"' with '"') is insufficient to prevent XSS, as it fails to escape other dangerous characters such as '<', '>', and '&'. An attacker can easily inject scripts using these characters, rendering the vulnerability real despite the partial sanitization.

evidence.note: Quote replacement is insufficient; sinks remain vulnerable to script tags and other HTML entities
